preconditions: Forms schemas are global and persisted in global/global core-data scope.
Schema writes use a server-generated UUID, globally unique key, expected_revision and CAS over one fake Core store.
scenarios.input: Create a schema, replay the same create, create another schema with the same key and different fields, update with the correct and a stale revision, rename and reuse the old key.
scenarios.action: Call SaveSchema on the Forms engine with an authenticated write principal and inspect persisted global records.
scenarios.expected_result: Identical creates are idempotent; duplicate keys, changed content under an existing key and stale revisions conflict; valid update increments version/revision and atomically releases the old key.
scenarios.expected_state: One schema record and one key-index record remain in global scope after rename, and the old key can be reused only by another schema.

preconditions: Field definitions are validated at schema save time independently of Router route validation.
Supported types and type-specific constraints are enumerated by the Forms contract.
scenarios.input: Save schemas with unknown fields, unsafe MIME types and invalid constraints, then save a schema using the supported text, email, number, boolean, select and file constraints.
scenarios.action: Call SaveSchema with typed field definitions and assert acceptance or rejection.
scenarios.expected_result: Unsafe or unknown field constraints are rejected; explicitly supported types, patterns, ranges, options and file limits are accepted and persisted unchanged.
scenarios.expected_state: No invalid schema is persisted; the accepted schema preserves its validated typed field definitions.

preconditions: A public form binding pins exactly one form ID and schema version; the visitor never supplies those values.
Visitor sessions, upload reservations and submissions are held in the Forms engine with fake Core/Loader boundaries.
scenarios.input: Create a visitor session, submit missing/invalid/unknown values, complete a valid submission, replay its idempotency key, retry a completed upload after submission and change the bound schema version.
scenarios.action: Call CreateVisitorSession, GetVisitorSession, upload/submit operations with the corresponding typed requests.
scenarios.expected_result: Invalid values are rejected, a valid accepted submission is immutable and idempotently replayed, completed upload retry is safe after submit, and a changed route version invalidates the old session.
scenarios.expected_state: The session ends in submitted state with verified values and attachment references; no session can cross a schema-version binding change.

preconditions: Schema and submission permissions are independent direct Core group levels.
Submissions require form_id filtering, immutable values, CAS status changes and final deletion with attachment cleanup.
scenarios.input: Exercise read/write principals from both groups, list with form/key/state selectors, change status with correct and stale revisions and delete after partial attachment cleanup.
scenarios.action: Call the Forms admin engine operations with the corresponding authenticated contexts and list/status/delete requests.
scenarios.expected_result: Each route enforces only its own group; lists return the filtered immutable submissions; stale status/delete CAS conflicts; resumed deletion removes all attachments and memberships.
scenarios.expected_state: No response is editable, no cross-group access is granted and a partially cleaned deletion reaches a terminal state without orphaned attachments.

preconditions: A disposable PostgreSQL/S3 stack and a live Router/Admin API built from this checkout are available.
Form-bound upload requires exact Router operation config, staging limits, a private destination and an external proxy for rate limiting.
scenarios.input: Drive public session, raw file upload, submit, resume after restart, CSV export and deletion through the real Router bindings using a disposable form and file set.
scenarios.action: Run the tagged HTTP/browser e2e flow with FORMS_TEST_DISPOSABLE=1 and the declared admin/public base URLs.
scenarios.expected_result: Cookies, exact routes, typed validation, upload idempotency, immutable submissions, CSV filtering/limits and final attachment cleanup match the OpenAPI and Forms contracts.
scenarios.expected_state: Without the isolated disposable stack the scenario is not executed and is never reported as pass.
scenarios.blocker: Disposable Forms environment not provided: require FORMS_TEST_DISPOSABLE=1, FORMS_TEST_ADMIN_BASE_URL, FORMS_TEST_PUBLIC_BASE_URL and FORMS_TEST_TIMEOUT. No live working API is used.
